title: I built my first game using Claude Code + ChatGPT
author: Inner_Ad5451
selftext:
Hey guys! Recently built and launched **Fit It: Pack the Moving Truck**.

I’m a product designer and wanted to try building a game from scratch. I ended up using AI a lot during the process.

I used Claude Code for the development — gameplay, level generation, UI, save system, analytics, testing, fixing bugs, etc. Basically, I’d explain what I wanted, let Claude implement it, test it, find what was broken or didn’t feel right, and iterate from there.

I made the game assets with ChatGPT and then cleaned them up and put everything together in the game.

Honestly, it was pretty crazy seeing an idea go from a rough concept to an actual playable game this way.

Would love to know how other people here are using AI while building games.
